name: HivemindOS Engineering Discipline
description: A risk-scoped engineering workflow combining HivemindOS Work Board evidence gates with curated planning, TDD, debugging, isolation, review, and completion methods from obra/superpowers.
audience: Agents doing ambiguous, risky, multi-step, or regression-prone software work.
safety: Installs local packaged files only. It never installs the upstream plugin, hooks, bootstrap, or brainstorming web server, and it grants no commit, push, merge, deletion, deployment, or agent-fan-out authority.
